    TRANSMISSION LINE PROJECT IN BELL, BURNET,
    CONCHO, CORYELL, LAMPASAS, LLANO, MASON,
   MCCULLOCH, MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN SABA,
SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES




                              SOAH ORDER NO. 23
                     REQUIRING APPLICANT FILING AND
  DENYING MOTION FOR ADDITIONAL PRE-HEARING CONFERENCE


      On May 19, 2026, the staff (Staff) of the Public Utility Commission of Texas
(Commission) filed a motion requesting: (1) an informational prehearing conference
held before June 3, 2026, to provide guidance to the parties on procedural matters
prior to the deadline for their prehearing submissions; (2) an earlier start time for the
 June 5, 2026 prehearing conference; (3) alignment of intervenors geographically,
such as by route links, in the order of presentation; and (4) bifurcation of the need
and routing issues during the hearing, with parties addressing need being grouped
for purposes of developing the order of presentation.


      The Administrative Law Judges (ALJs) conclude that bifurcation of the need
issue does not have any efficiency advantages, as the same witnesses would be called
multiple times in an already pressed hearing schedule. Also, because some
intervenors are challenging both need and routing, the ALJs find that it would be
more efficient to group intervenors by route segment, rather than by challenges to
need. The need issue and routing issue shall be addressed in separate sections of
post-hearing briefs.


      The ALJs intend to issue an informational order which provides guidance on
how to submit pre-hearing submissions, including the exhibit list and witness
cross-examination list. Because the ALJs need time after the June 3 deadline for
prehearing submissions to assemble a list of the exhibits for admission, which the
ALJs will memorialize in an order before the prehearing conference, the prehearing
conference cannot begin earlier than 1:00 p.m. on June 5, 2026. Therefore,
Commission Staff’s motion for an informational pre-hearing conference and to
change the time for the June 5 prehearing conference is DENIED.


      Alignment among intervenors is encouraged. Intervenors who wish to align
should file notice of their alignment as soon as possible but no later than
June 2, 2026.

                                               2
                                     SOAH Order No. 23
                       SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
       By June 3, 2026, Applicants shall file a spreadsheet, in native format, listing
all intervenors, grouped by route segments to the extent possible. This list shall serve
as the basis for the proposed order of cross-examination and presentation at the
hearing.


Signed May 29, 2026
